dataClient.heroDesc: Market prices depend on players using the Albion Online Data Client. The more players install it, the fresher the data everyone gets.
dataClient.why1Desc: Every item you browse in the market is sent to the community. Other players see prices almost instantly.
dataClient.why2Desc: More players in different cities means a more complete price map across the whole server.
dataClient.why3Desc: The Albion Data Project is free, no ads, no telemetry. Just market data for the whole community.
dataClient.step1Desc: Go to albion-online-data.com and download the installer for Windows, Mac or Linux.
dataClient.step2Desc: Run the installer and open the Albion Online Data Client. It runs in the background.
dataClient.step3Desc: Open Albion Online normally. The client auto-detects and starts collecting data.
dataClient.step4Desc: Every time you open the market in any city, prices are captured and shared. Done!
dataClient.ctaNote: Free, open-source and safe. Compatible with Albion Online's Terms of Service.
